scope: Tab-specific existing draft and registered validation state; current hierarchy batch remains independent.
source_findings: sectionMetadata currently covers loaded history counts/retry only; it has no draft or registered field-error contribution.
dirty compares whole draft/member JSON. Details owns canonical_name,active_status,call_level; Roles owns designations and call_level_changes; Names owns aliases.
validateDraft records all local errors before routing to Details or Roles and focusing first existing control. Existing input/change clearing semantics must remain intact.
status updates currently change footer state; tab metadata must refresh without replacing focused inputs or altering selection.
Server save failures are generic existing error messages; do not infer field ownership from error text.
implementation_constraints: Derive presentation markers from existing exact section comparisons and registered fieldErrors, not new validation or persistence rules.
Combine draft/error metadata with existing loaded-count/retry descriptions; preserve role=tab, roving tabindex, count meaning, vocabulary and keyboard behavior.
Update badges and aria-description without stealing focus or rerendering ordinary input on each keystroke.
Existing save/discard/validation routing, API body, authorization checks and error-clearing behavior remain unchanged.
Legacy is a linear form view; expose section-specific draft/error status without artificial tabs or changed save actions.
necessary_tests: Multiple changed sections, return-to-base values, hidden local errors and first-invalid routing.
Native keyboard access to marked section/field, unchanged selected tab during ordinary typing and cursor selection preservation.
Confirmed discard, refused discard, successful mocked exact-payload save, save failure and retained drafts.
Loaded-count/retry and tab keyboard regressions remain correct alongside new markers.
